Something went wrong?

For bugs, questions, feedback or privacy requests, email:

Against All Ads is currently in testing for Android. A public Google Play release is not available yet.

Help us find the bug

  • Tell us your game version, phone model and Android version.
  • Describe the mode, floor and what you did just before the problem.
  • A screenshot or short recording helps. Please remove personal information first.
  • Tell us whether the problem happens every time or only occasionally.
Write a bug report ↗

Progress and settings

Your progress is saved locally. Clearing Android app storage removes it. Music and effects volume, gameplay statistics and available advertising privacy choices are in the game's Settings.

Privacy and deletion requests

Read the privacy policy for details about local saves, advertising and optional analytics. To request help accessing or deleting personal data, email us with the subject “Against All Ads privacy request”. No game account or sign-in is required.
